nutrition.mpIntroDefault: Dear {name}, here are your recommendations for a healthy eating plan based on what you shared with us. It takes your preferences and lifestyle into account so you can reach your goal. Pick freely between the options in each meal category, and reach out any time you have a question.
nutrition.mpIntroClosing: Enjoy these recipes, and if you have any questions about this plan, do not hesitate to reach out. All the best!
nutrition.mpDisclaimer: Please note that this meal plan only serves as a suggestion of healthy eating patterns and is not intended to replace dietary counseling from a dietitian, nutritionist, or medical professional. Use of all meal plans is at your own risk. Always review the contents for anything you may be allergic or intolerant to. Following a meal plan does not guarantee any particular health outcome, including weight loss. If you have specific questions about your health or your individual nutrient needs, please consult your medical provider, especially if you are being treated for a medical condition.
nutrition.mpDeficitNote: Because your goal is to lose weight, your body should be in a gentle calorie deficit; this plan is built for that.
nutrition.mpEnergyNote: Your targets come from your basal metabolic rate, activity level, and goal. Protein and carbs provide about 4 kcal per gram and fat about 9 kcal per gram; the recipes in each category are built so any option keeps your day on target.
nutrition.mpTipWeigh: Ingredient amounts are RAW weight unless stated otherwise. Weigh before cooking, and only the part you will actually eat.
nutrition.mpTipSpices: Spices and seasonings are there for flavor. Swap or skip any you dislike; just read labels if you have allergies.
nutrition.mpTipPrep: Prep several portions at once: multiply a recipe, portion into containers, fridge for a few days or freeze for later.
nutrition.mpTipWeekly: It is what you eat over the WEEK that determines results, not any single meal. Be flexible with meal times; find the rhythm that fits your life.
nutrition.photoLowQualityBoth: This photo is dark and blurry.
nutrition.photoLowQualityHelp: A brighter, sharper shot will be much more accurate.

disclaimer.title: Before you begin
disclaimer.p1: Thick & Fit provides fitness and nutrition guidance for general wellness. It is not medical advice and is not a substitute for care from a licensed healthcare provider.
disclaimer.p2: Consult your doctor before starting any exercise or nutrition program, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, or have a medical condition. Stop and seek help if you feel pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath.
disclaimer.p3: By continuing, you confirm you are at least 18, are participating voluntarily, and accept the risks of physical activity.

faq.title: Everything you're wondering
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about how Thick & Fit works, what it costs, and who it's for.
faq.ctaBody: Come see what Stephanie built. It's not a race, it's a marathon.

items.a: Thick & Fit is a bilingual fitness coaching app built by coach Stephanie Pantoja for women. You get structured workout programs with her filmed demos, nutrition tracking that handles real home cooking, a community, and coaching in her method. Everything works in English or Spanish.

items.q: Is Thick & Fit available in Spanish?
items.a: Yes. Every screen works fully in Spanish or English, and you pick your language when you sign up. Your coaching answers in the language you write in. This is not a half-translated app: the member side and the coaching side are both bilingual.

items.q: How much does Thick & Fit cost?
items.a: Foundation is $19.97 per month for founding members who join in the 5-day founding window at launch; standard price is $24.97 per month after. That includes the full app: her filmed workouts, photo nutrition tracking, her meal-plan method, progress + check-ins, community, and the coach in your language.

No free trial, but no contract either. Cancel anytime in one tap and you keep access through the end of the billing period you already paid for. Your logged workouts, weigh-ins and progress photos stay in your account, and you can export them whenever you want. No tricks.

items.q: How does the food photo tracking work?
items.a: You take a photo of your meal and the app estimates what is on the plate and how much. It matches those foods to a nutrition database, converts between raw and cooked weights, and logs your real macros. You can correct any portion, and it learns from your corrections.
No. You tell the app what you have access to, whether that is a full gym, dumbbells, bands, or just your body, and your program is built around that.
Yes. You choose your experience level during setup and your program is matched to it. It's not a race, it's a marathon, and the app is built to meet you where you are.

Stephanie Pantoja, a bilingual fitness coach for women across the US and Latin America. The workouts, the meal-plan method, and the coaching voice are all hers. She built the app so her coaching lives somewhere she owns.
Yes, in one tap from your account, with no retention maze and no hidden auto-renew traps. You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

items.q: What if I have PCOS, an injury, or foods I can't eat?
items.a: You tell the app during setup. Things like PCOS, insulin resistance, thyroid conditions, injuries, allergies, and foods you avoid all shape your macros, your meal plans, and what your coach suggests. It will never recommend a food you said you can't eat.

about.metaDesc: Thick & Fit is a bilingual fitness coaching app built by coach Stephanie Pantoja for women in the US and Latin America. Workouts, nutrition, community, and coaching in English or Spanish.
about.intro: Thick & Fit is the bilingual coaching app Stephanie Pantoja built for her clients, because nothing she could buy was made for them. Not for women who live between English and Spanish. Not for women who want real math behind their macros. Not for women who deserve better than an app that dims the screen mid set.
about.originHead: She outgrew the tools before she outgrew the work.
about.originA: Stephanie is a certified personal trainer coaching women across the US and Latin America. The same complaint came back from client after client: logging food was the hardest part of the day. Photographing a label into a chat window. Guessing whether the number on the package meant cooked or raw. Searching for the food her family actually cooks and finding nothing.
about.originB: So she stopped working around the problem and built the thing that solves it. This app is her method, her programming, and her voice, on a platform she owns.

diffs.t: Food logging that survives real cooking
diffs.d: Photograph the plate and get the items back with calories, protein, carbs and fat. It handles cooked versus raw weight, and the food database covers what your family actually cooks, not just what is sold in a US supermarket.

diffs.t: A workout that does not fight you
diffs.d: The screen stays awake for the whole session, so you are not tapping your phone between sets. The timer is real audio rather than a video file, so it still works on bad gym wifi. No barbell today? You get a substitution she picked, not a generic swap.

diffs.t: It tells you what to do next
diffs.d: You rate how the session felt. The app reads your recent sessions and recommends your next weight and rep target using double progression, which is standard sports science. The math is shown, not hidden.

Interface language and content language are separate settings. Read the app in English and search food in Spanish, or follow a program in Spanish with labels in English. It is a bilingual database, not English with a translation layer on top.

Challenges with live leaderboards, coach broadcasts in both languages, and groups that match the ones her clients already belong to. Built so there is a reason to come back today, not just when you remember.

Your next charge date is always visible. You get a warning before you renew. Cancelling takes one tap with no maze of confirmation screens. Honest billing is treated as a feature here, not an afterthought.

about.whoA: The women who follow Stephanie: bilingual, in the US and across Latin America, motivated but not obsessive, and done managing one app for macros and another for workouts.
about.whoB: Many of them move between Spanish and English depending on who they are talking to. Every other fitness app makes them pick one. This one does not.
about.ctaBody: It is not a race, it is a marathon. Start whenever you are ready.
